import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        
        if (n == 0) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        
        int k = n / 2;
        PriorityQueue<Integer> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            pq.offer(x);
            if (pq.size() > k + 1) {
                pq.poll();
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(pq.peek());
    }
}
